regions.merged_text: THE TRANSFIXION: "Blessed be God in all His designs! The following pages recount the sorros of Mary - the Virgin of all blessed virgins" THE CONCEPTION: "Blessed be God in all His design! This "The Mystical City of God.," in my conviction is the real life of the Blessed Mother of God - Mary Immaculate ever Virgin - Queen of the Universe. If full resuls are to be expected the reader will do well to pray to the Holy Gost at least briefly and humbly before each reading - as is becomingly done at the reading of other "inspired works."
